racers.name: Turbo Tails
racers.bio: The reigning champion with aerodynamic ears and a low center of gravity. Known for aggressive cornering.

racers.name: Lightning McFluff
racers.bio: Young prodigy with exceptional fluff-to-speed ratio. Sponsors include Premium Kibble Co.

racers.name: Sir Waddles III
racers.bio: Maximum fluffiness may impact aerodynamics, but his dignity is unmatched on the track.

racers.name: Zoom Zoom
racers.bio: Sacrificed fluff for pure velocity. Holds lap record at Barkcelona Circuit.

racers.name: Buttercup
racers.bio: Don't let the name fool you - fierce competitor with a sweet tooth for victory.

racers.name: Captain Stubby
racers.bio: Former search and rescue corgi turned racer. Excellent in wet conditions.

racers.name: Professor Snoot
racers.bio: PhD in Aerodynamics. Applies scientific method to racing strategy.

racers.name: Duchess Floofington
racers.bio: Races in a custom diamond-studded collar. Insists on premium track conditions.

racers.name: Bark Hamilton
racers.bio: Living legend. #BlessedWithTreats. Seven-time runner-up, but who's counting?

racers.name: Señor Chorizo
racers.bio: Fan favorite known for celebratory zoomies. Sponsored by local tapas bar.

racers.name: Pixel
racers.bio: E-sports champion turned real racer. Still learning the 'smell other dogs' feature.

racers.name: Biscuit
racers.bio: Runs on pure carbohydrates. Often distracted by trackside snack vendors.

events.name: Monaco Grand Paws
events.description: The most prestigious race on the calendar. Narrow streets require maximum concentration and minimum butt wiggling.

events.name: British Grand Paws
events.description: Historic track where legends are made. Watch for the famous Copse Corner treats station.

events.name: Japanese Grand Paws
events.description: Figure-eight layout tests steering precision. Post-race sushi for all participants.

events.name: Italian Grand Paws
events.description: Temple of Speed where corgis reach maximum velocity. Ears must be pinned back for aerodynamics.

events.name: Australian Grand Paws
events.description: Season opener in the land down under. Beware of kangaroo crossing zones.

events.name: Belgian Grand Paws
events.description: Famous for unpredictable weather. Completed race saw record-breaking ear flapping.

rules.title: Mandatory Ear Position
rules.description: Ears must remain floppy during the formation lap. Perked ears constitute an unfair aerodynamic advantage and will result in a 5-second penalty.

rules.title: The Sacred Butt Wiggle
rules.description: Excessive butt wiggling during overtaking maneuvers is prohibited, as it may hypnotize competitors. Maximum 3 wiggles per lap permitted.

rules.title: Treat Distribution
rules.description: All racers must receive equal treat distribution at pit stops. Premium treats (bacon flavor) are banned as performance-enhancing substances.

rules.title: Nap Time Regulations
rules.description: Mandatory 15-minute nap time after every 20 laps. Failure to nap results in crankiness penalties.

rules.title: Zoomies Zone
rules.description: Post-race victory zoomies must be contained within designated celebration areas. Random zoomies on track during race are grounds for disqualification.

rules.title: Sploot Protocol
rules.description: The 'sploot' position is only allowed during caution periods. Racing while splooting is dangerous and adorable, therefore illegal.

rules.title: Collar Regulations
rules.description: Racing collars must not exceed 2cm in width. Jeweled collars permitted but must not create blinding reflections that distract other racers.

rules.title: Bark Communications
rules.description: Radio communications with pit crew via barks must be clear and concise. Excessive barking at squirrels is not race-related communication.

rules.title: Leg Length Fairness
rules.description: All racers acknowledge that short legs are a feature, not a bug. Complaints about leg length ratio to body size will not be entertained.

rules.title: Weather Conditions
rules.description: In wet conditions, racers must accept that their fluff will poof to 150% normal volume. Anti-poof products are banned substances.

rules.title: Pit Stop Belly Rubs
rules.description: Mandatory belly rubs during tire changes. Minimum 3 rubs, maximum 10. Any pit crew member failing to provide adequate belly rubs faces fine.

rules.title: Track Limits
rules.description: All four paws must remain on track surface. Exceptions made for particularly exciting smells just off track - judges review on case-by-case basis.
